cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Choose the Precedent
cards.instruction: Make someone choose which rule, custom, or prior decision will govern what happens now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. The handbook says lock the hall at six. Our festival permit says stay open till eight. Which governs tonight?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Keep the front open and lock the back.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. So the permit governs public access, and the handbook governs everything else?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. Including the kitchen closing at six.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then are we canceling the seven-o'clock supper, or does the permit govern kitchens too?

mechanism: A copies smoothing a handbook as precedence and covers by making B choose a governing rule, then testing its concrete consequence.
confusable: D178 makes B select among rules; D173 proves one already determines duty.
comparison: Conflicting hall hours versus conflicting family precedence.
seedUse: Keep B kitchen closure and the seven-o-clock supper as the actual unresolved consequence.
